title: Natsu
description: A railway crossing signal and its overhead wires, black against a cumulonimbus towering into deep summer blue, taken apart into its real layers: the signal, the wires, the cloud and the sky. Raise the pointer and the camera tips up beneath them, one turn of one lens for every layer: the mast and the gantry lean in toward the zenith, the wires run off in long arcs to their vanishing point, and new sky opens over the gantry, deepening to cobalt. Hold and it tips all the way, a worm's-eye into the sun behind the tower: the faces it lit go to skylight blue and the edges facing it catch a warm rim. The cloud keeps growing from its own texture, its lobes swelling one after another while the curd inside churns, and the wires sway on their springs. Now and then a train comes and the crossing lamps start to alternate.
intent: Genre spec idea 4, Natsu (factory/reality/genre-spec.md section 4), after herb's reference 3 (a utility pole and wires against towering cumulus) and Makoto Shinkai's summer skies: the moment alive inside the computer, from one photograph split into depth layers. Reference: https://unsplash.com/photos/black-electric-post-under-blue-sky-and-white-clouds-during-daytime-4JKUDDo-Or4 . ?t=0..1 growth, ?light=0..1 sun (else it follows the pitch), ?tilt=x,y look (y -1 = highest), ?pitch=0..42 degrees, ?lamp=1|2 holds a lamp lit.

sources.author: Kanata (@tanakanata), Unsplash
sources.note: 5184x3456 Canon EOS 60D original, worked at 2592x1728. Depth from Depth Anything V2 (tools/depth/depth_hr.py). Silhouettes matted against an inpainted background (alpha = (I-B)·(F-B)/|F-B|²), split into a near layer (signal, crossbuck, lamps) and a wire layer (catenary, gantry, masts) by depth with hysteresis; the wires hidden behind the signal continued by inpainting. Sky refit as a smooth quadratic in linear light from the visible blue; the cloud kept as its excess over that sky, with normals, cloudness and an activity mask derived from its own shading.
